# Customize brand

The brand tokens set the hues, the fonts, and the shape of all components. Every color derives from a hue and a chroma: the color scales are computed from them on a fixed lightness curve, so a brand sets two numbers per color instead of a scale, and all color schemes follow.

`@dextinity/ui` has the brands `dextinity` and `ai-hub`. To add your own:

1. Create a global stylesheet. Put its rules outside any cascade layer.
2. In a rule on `[data-dextinity-brand="<name>"]`, set the brand tokens that you want to change.
3. Import the stylesheet once in your application.
4. Pass the name to the `brand` prop of `Theme`.
5. Check the components in all color schemes.

This stylesheet makes an orange-red the primary color, and decreases the corner radius of controls, such as buttons:

```css
[data-dextinity-brand="acme"] {
    --dextinity-brand-primary-hue: 30;
    --dextinity-brand-primary-chroma: 0.2;
    --dextinity-brand-radius-control: 6px;
}
```

```tsx
<Theme brand="acme">{/* … */}</Theme>
```

If your styles use cascade layers, put the rules in a layer after the layer of the library:

```css
@layer dextinity, brand;

@layer brand {
    [data-dextinity-brand="acme"] {
        /* … */
    }
}
```

## Brand tokens

A hue is an OKLCH hue angle from 0 to 360, and a chroma is the OKLCH chroma of the most saturated step, for example `0.2`.

```text
--dextinity-brand-primary-hue, --dextinity-brand-primary-chroma
--dextinity-brand-secondary-hue, --dextinity-brand-secondary-chroma
--dextinity-brand-gradient-hue
--dextinity-brand-neutral-hue, --dextinity-brand-neutral-chroma
--dextinity-brand-success-hue
--dextinity-brand-danger-hue

--dextinity-brand-font-family-text
--dextinity-brand-font-family-display
--dextinity-brand-font-family-mono
--dextinity-brand-font-size
--dextinity-brand-display-font-weight
--dextinity-brand-display-letter-spacing
--dextinity-brand-display-text-transform

--dextinity-brand-radius-control
--dextinity-brand-radius-factor
```

`--dextinity-brand-radius-control` is the corner radius of controls. `--dextinity-brand-radius-factor` scales all other corner radii: `0` makes them square, `1` keeps them.

## Replace the font

The components take their font from a brand token, not from the font of the page. Load your font, and set the token to it. If your font loader gives you a CSS variable instead of a font name, set that variable on the `html` element.

```css
[data-dextinity-brand="acme"] {
    --dextinity-brand-font-family-text: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;
    --dextinity-brand-font-family-display: "Source Sans 3", sans-serif;
}
```

## Replace icons

A brand can also replace icons: set their variables in the same rule. See [Customize icons](?path=/docs/foundations-icons-customize-icons--docs).

```css
[data-dextinity-brand="acme"] {
    --dextinity-icon-add: url("./icons/add.svg#icon");
}
```

## Customize a part of the application

To use another brand in one part of your application, wrap that part in another `Theme` with its own `brand`. A nested `Theme` resolves all tokens against its own brand, color scheme, and density.
